2607.14614.title: Beyond Entropy: Correctness-Aware Advantage Shaping via Contrastive Policy Optimization
2607.14614.paper_summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) commonly uses entropy for advantage shaping. However, entropy cannot distinguish useful uncertainty from detrimental confusion, limiting its effectiveness as a correctness signal. We propose Contrastive Policy Optimization (CPO), which uses token-level contrastive disagreement between reference-guided and vanilla generation distributions for correctness-aware advantage shaping. Both theoretical and empirical results show that this disagreement reliably indicates token-level correctness. We further show that On-policy Distillation is a special case of CPO, where the posterior distribution is instantiated by an external teacher model. CPO also resolves the zero-advantage problem. Experiments on in-domain and out-of-domain benchmarks demonstrate that CPO substantially outperforms entropy-based RLVR methods while maintaining strong generalization. Further analysis shows that correct and incorrect responses naturally support exploration and exploitation respectively, and balancing both leads to the best performance.
2607.14614.paper_summary_zh: 強化學習與可驗證獎勵（RLVR）通常使用熵來進行優勢塑形。<lb/>然而，熵無法區分有用的不確定性與有害的混淆，限制了其作為正確性信號的有效性。<lb/>我們提出了對比策略優化（CPO），它利用參考引導和普通生成分佈之間的令牌級對比不一致性來進行正確性意識的優勢塑形。<lb/>理論和實證結果均顯示，這種不一致性可靠地指示了令牌級的正確性。<lb/>我們進一步表明，策略蒸餾是CPO的一個特例，其中後驗分佈由外部教師模型實例化。<lb/>CPO還解決了零優勢問題。<lb/>在領域內和領域外基準上的實驗顯示，CPO在保持強大泛化的同時，顯著超越了基於熵的RLVR方法。<lb/>進一步的分析顯示，正確和不正確的回應自然分別支持探索和利用，而平衡兩者則導致最佳性能。
